# The Discombobulator

> Legacy software → FallWorld-native sovereign RE-GROWTH. A guided pipeline that ingests a
> client's legacy system, understands what it DOES (not how it's coded), re-grows a sovereign
> build that does the same job, PROVES equivalence on the system's own held-out cases, and
> migrates the data across. Functionally equivalent, structurally superior, owned by them.

## What it is
Not a copier (a byte-identical copy reproduces the old flaws — soft, un-sovereign, black-box).
A RE-GROWER: extract the function as verified patterns, grow a new FallWorld-native organ that
reproduces it, prove equivalence on real cases, migrate the data.

## The five gated stages
1. INGEST — inventory the code, config, schema and data; sample the legacy as a black-box oracle.
2. UNDERSTAND — induce the decision function as patterns (two grown organs: a status organ and a
   tier organ); each leaf is proved on a held-out VALIDATE slice, low-confidence leaves flagged as
   candidate MISunderstandings. The hard, valuable part.
3. RE-GROW — grow a sovereign build from the spec: SENTINEL-defended (signed, κ-witnessed packets),
   Konomi-compressed pattern book, proof-chain transparent, grow-not-install.
4. VERIFY-EQUIVALENT — run the legacy's REAL held-out cases through BOTH old and new; assert same
   output; surface EVERY mismatch and attribute it to a candidate tribal rule. The gate is the safety.
5. MIGRATE — schema-transform the records; count / null / checksum / roundtrip integrity checks.

## Proven on
A synthetic but faithful legacy system, "LoanDesk 2011": an undocumented 1,200-record credit-decision
engine with ~80% clean threshold rules and ~20% gnarly, undocumented tribal rules (a regional
grandfather clause, a product guardrail, a date-bound promo).

## Honest v1
A guided pipeline, not a one-click vending machine. The common rules extract automatically; the
gnarly ones are flagged for a human to confirm in a moment. Some things don't translate at all and
would be bridged, not re-grown — flagged up front. The un-forgeable proof is the CI re-run on the
runner, re-derived from the sealed inputs.

## Credits
Built on the Konomi architecture and LIGHT, created by Thomas Frumkin (the primorial-fold codec in
SENTINEL). Organs reuse pattern-organs (the Pattern Organ and held-out prove-gate) and fall-spore
(grow-from-seed), both sjgant80-hub. Equivalence enforced by the witness mutation gate.
